title: A Future Inspired by Ladyland
description: In “A Future Inspired by Ladyland,” by Malika H., an EmpowerHer student, the writer reflects on Sultana's Dream and its powerful vision of a society built on equality and knowledge. Connecting the story's imagined world to the realities faced by Afghan women today, the piece explores freedom, justice, and the hope for a future where women and men stand side by side with equal rights and opportunities.
